name: data-protection
description: Data protection in the processing of personal data under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (2016/679) and the Data Protection Act (tietosuojalaki 1050/2018): assessing the processing and the need for a DPIA, the privacy notice and the record of processing activities, and responding to requests from data subjects.
